I've attached an updated .ics (20270330-demo-invite.ics) and pasted the event block below so you can verify before accepting:

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
BEGIN:VEVENT
DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20270405T230000
DTEND;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20270405T233000
SUMMARY:Redwood Technical Demo — Bellwether
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR

Please accept the new invite; if anyone still sees a midnight rollover, try removing the original ghost event first (search for events created on Apr 5 by michael@redwood.ai) — Google sometimes keeps a floating duplicate.

Also FYI Rachel and I will join for the Q&A and we'll open the session for live perf testing.

Thanks,
